## Calendly Bookings to Notion CRM

Every discovery call booked in Calendly appears in your Notion CRM before the meeting - name, email, meeting time, and their answers to your screening questions.

**Setup time:** 10 minutes  ·  **Level:** Beginner

**You'll need accounts/credentials for:** Calendly, Notion

**Replace these before running:**
- `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_DATABASE`

**Setup steps:**
1. Connect Calendly with a personal access token in the trigger node.
2. Connect Notion: share your CRM database with your integration, then select it in the Notion node.
3. Match the property names in the Notion node to your database columns (template expects: Name, Email, Meeting, Date, Notes).
4. Activate and book a test slot on your own Calendly.

Free templates and updates: navkhan103.github.io

### How it runs

Starts from **New Booking**.

1. A Calendly Trigger fires when an invitee books (invitee.created).
2. A Code node extracts name, email, event type, start time, and any custom question answers.
3. A Notion node creates a page in your CRM database with those properties.

### If something breaks

The read and AI nodes here **retry 3× automatically** (5s apart), which absorbs rate limits and brief timeouts.

Nodes that **send or write deliberately do not retry** — a send that reached the far end but lost its response would otherwise fire twice, so you'd get duplicate messages or duplicate rows.

To be told when one of those fails, build a workflow starting with an **Error Trigger** node that posts to Slack or email, then set it under **three-dot menu > Settings > Error Workflow**. Do it once and point every workflow at it.
